```{r}
library(forecast)
```

```{r}
germany <- vaccinations_country %>%
  filter(location == "Germany") %>%
  arrange(date)

ts_germany <- ts(
  germany$people_fully_vaccinated_per_hundred,
  frequency = 7
)
```

```{r}
fit <- auto.arima(ts_germany)
summary(fit)
```

```{r}
forecast_30 <- forecast(
  fit,
  h = 30
)

plot(forecast_30)
```

```{r}
fit_ets <- ets(ts_germany)

fc_ets <- forecast(
  fit_ets,
  h = 30
)

autoplot(fc_ets)
```
